answer: Shards are assigned from the ember graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The bridge assignment is published and lagoon records each panel. A farm of 2600 identities would post 3223 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
